description:

Started in 2020, the club is located conveniently in Wadala West. It has some of the finest recreational facilities available such as - Squash Court, Badminton Court, Billiards, Table Tennis, Card Room and a Swimming Pool. We also provide a well- equipped gymnasium for the benefit of the members. Our members and their guests can enjoy scrumptious food at the air-conditioned restaurant. There is also a provision for parties and group gatherings with limited guest capacity.

The club also has car parking facility for members.

featured_reviews.name: aditi mane
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have visited Wadala Sports Club multiple times, either for bookings or to enquire about facilities. Unfortunately, the experience has been consistently disappointing because of the rude and unprofessional behaviour of the receptionist and some staff members who seevrely lack professionalism and customer retention.

On one occasion some 3-4 months back during heavy rains, I was left stranded at the entrance with my car because the parking gate was shut and no watchman was present. There was another car parked blocking the entrace of the parking and there was no way to park the car near the gate as it would have caused nuisance to others. we opened the gate ourselves but struggled with where to park the car. Despite clearly seeing the situation stading on the main door of the club, the receptionist refused to offer any assistance or even call someone to guide us. Instead, I had to leave my car outside and then walk in the rain to enter the club, and ended up drenched while entering the club for an event. Later, I saw the same receptionist casually sitting with the watchman he had claimed was unavailable.

On another occasion, when I visited with a friend to enquire about the club’s sports activities and fees, his attitude was dismissive. He simply told us to “read the circular” and refused to answer any questions, even when we had doubts after reading the notice. Instead of being welcoming and helpful, he was curt and arrogant — an attitude unbecoming of the first point of contact for a members’ club.

The club facilities may be good, but this kind of customer-facing behaviour reflects very poorly on the institution. Members and visitors expect courtesy, guidance, and respect, not indifference and attitude.

Unless the management takes steps to train or replace such staff, I cant whole heartedly recommend Wadala Sports Club.

featured_reviews.name: Nirav Gangar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited a few times here for dinners & lunches now and had an amazing experience both the times.

Below are the food items we have tried here -
1. Sweet corn soup - It was nice and sweet.
2. Burnt garlic soup - Loved the taste. Highly recommend having it if you like garlic and soups.
3. Lemon coriander soup - It was a nice soup. Can try.
4. Lotus Kurkure with schezwan sauce - You love having lotus stem roots then this is a must order for you. Right amount of crispy and tasty.
5. Waterchest nut in sambal sauce - Enjoyed this starter as well. Very well made and can order during the waterchest nut season.
6. Special stuff kulcha - It was nice and stuffed well. It became very filling just having 1 portion of the kulcha with the vegetables.
8. Veg. Makhmali - finely chopped mix vegetable sabzi in red gravy. Have visited the restaurant many times now and this is the one which I have loved the most and the taste has been the same always and never disappointed.
9. Lasuni Paneer - paneer pieces in yellow lasuni gravy.
10. Paneer veg Diwani masala - Nice mix vegetable medium chopped with paneer pieces in red gravy.
11. Orange mojito - It was very sweet so did not like it as we were expecting it to have a tangy flavour.
12. Ginger twist - It was flavourful and absolutely loved having it as I love ginger.
13. Masala chaas - It was very refreshing. Highly recommended.
14. Roti - In roties, we have tried many and would only say that you can order whichever you liked. You won’t go wrong. They have Garlic option in all the Indian breads so that is fantastic.

All in all it’s an amazing restaurant for North Indian food in Matunga area if you are a member or know someone who is.

featured_reviews.name: Sachin Boga
featured_reviews.review_text: Kamgar Swimming Pool is one of Mumbai’s most popular and affordable public swimming facilities, located in the central Dadar–Parel area, making it highly accessible for residents across the city. Known for its large indoor pool and well-structured setup, it caters to both beginners and experienced swimmers, offering coaching sessions as well as general swimming access at reasonable rates. The facility has undergone upgrades in recent years, with improved changing rooms, lighting, and additional sports amenities within the complex, making it more modern and user-friendly.   One of its biggest advantages is its affordability and inclusivity, as it was originally designed to support workers and the general public, yet it continues to attract a diverse crowd including fitness enthusiasts and corporate members.   The pool is spacious and suitable for training, with varying depths that accommodate different skill levels, but it can get quite crowded during peak hours, especially in the summer season. While maintenance and cleanliness are generally decent, the high footfall sometimes affects the overall experience. Despite minor drawbacks like crowding and waiting time, Kamgar Swimming Pool remains a reliable and value-for-money option for swimming in Mumbai, especially for those looking for a centrally located and budget-friendly facility.

featured_reviews.name: Gurvinder Pal Singh Kalra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Title: A Refreshing Oasis in the Heart of Mumbai

As a resident of Mahim, I've been frequenting the Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool for many years, and I've always been impressed by its facilities and the overall swimming experience it offers. While there's always room for improvement, I believe the pool deserves a solid 4-star rating, reflecting its strengths and acknowledging the areas where it could enhance its offerings.

Cleanliness and Maintenance:

The pool complex is generally well-maintained, with clean and hygienic pools, changing rooms, and shower areas. The staff regularly checks the water quality, ensuring it meets the necessary standards. While there have been instances of minor cleanliness issues, they've been promptly addressed by the staff.

Facilities and Amenities:

The pool complex boasts a variety of amenities catering to swimmers of all ages and skill levels. The main pool, an Olympic-sized one, is ideal for lap swimming and training. The separate diving pool is perfect for practicing dives and aquatic stunts. Additionally, there's a smaller pool for kids, providing a safe and fun environment for them to learn and enjoy the water.

Pool Staff and Safety:

The pool staff is generally helpful and attentive, ensuring the safety of swimmers at all times. Experienced lifeguards are stationed around the pools, keeping a watchful eye on everyone. The pool also has clear signage and safety guidelines in place to minimize the risk of accidents.

Overall Experience:

Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool is a great place to come for a refreshing swim, whether you're looking for a leisurely workout or a fun family outing. The pool's facilities are well-maintained, the staff is friendly and helpful, and the safety measures are commendable. While there's always room for improvement, the pool consistently delivers a positive swimming experience, earning it a solid 4-star rating.

Areas for Improvement:

Parking: The pool's parking facilities can be limited during peak hours, making it challenging to find a spot. Expanding the parking area or introducing valet parking services would be beneficial.

Shower Rooms: The shower rooms could be refurbished to provide a more modern and comfortable experience. Upgrading the fixtures and adding more shower cubicles would enhance the overall experience.

Food Options: While there are a few snack and beverage options available at the canteen it closes by 9 pm and expanding the food menu to include more substantial meals would cater to swimmers who spend longer hours at the pool.

Despite these areas for improvement, Mahatma Gandhi Swimming Pool remains a valuable asset to the Dadar community and a popular choice for both casual swimmers and fitness enthusiasts. Its dedication to cleanliness, safety, and providing a welcoming environment makes it a rewarding place to spend a day in the water.
